message.content:
I’m not able to pull live exchange‑rate data, but as of the most recent rates (late 2025/early 2026) the U.S. dollar trades roughly at **$1 ≈ £0.78**. Using that figure:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \;\approx\; £15.60
\]

So about **£15½–£16** would be the equivalent of $20.  

Keep in mind that rates fluctuate daily, so you’ll want to check a reliable financial source or your bank’s rate for the exact amount at the time of your transaction.
